warnings.why: the fibre composition of a textile product is mandatory on the label and before purchase, also online: Reg. (EU) No 1007/2011 Art. 9, 11 and 16(1). For bags and luggage it applies when the product is a textile product (at least 80 % textile fibres by weight, Art. 2(2))

warnings.when: a textile item type with `contains_animal_origin` empty while `materials` has a fibre `leather`, `suede`, `fur`, `down`, `feather`, `wool` (or a kind of wool such as `merino_wool`, `lambswool`, `cashmere`, `alpaca`, `mohair`) or `silk`
warnings.why: a textile product with non-textile parts of animal origin must say so on the label: Reg. (EU) No 1007/2011 Art. 12. Wool and silk are textile fibres and do not need the statement themselves; the warning asks the brand to state `yes` or `no`

warnings.when: a footwear item type without `footwear_materials`, or with one of its three parts empty
warnings.why: the material of the upper, the lining and sock and the outer sole is mandatory on footwear labels: Directive 94/11/EC

warnings.when: a part of `materials` whose percentages do not sum to 100 (one per part)
warnings.why: the composition is given as percentages of the total fibre weight: Reg. (EU) No 1007/2011 Art. 9 (and Art. 11 per component)
